title: Jargon That Hides in Plain Sight
text:
Some technical words look ordinary, which makes them more dangerous rather than less. A lawyer who says a clause is 'boilerplate' signals that its language is standard and therefore expected to be uncontroversial, yet the phrase may conceal an obligation that a layperson would never notice. Specialists rely on this familiarity to communicate efficiently, but outsiders can mistake a routine term for a casual one.

Academics face a similar problem with words like 'significant', which in statistics denotes a threshold of probability rather than importance in the everyday sense. A reader who takes the word at face value may overestimate the consequence of a finding. Good writers therefore define such terms at first use, so that the ordinary meaning does not silently replace the technical one.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what does a lawyer signal when calling a clause 'boilerplate'?
options: That the clause is a rare exception
That its language is standard and expected to be uncontroversial
That the clause must be removed
That the clause is written in Latin

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what does 'significant' denote in statistics?
options: The number of participants in a study

questions.text: What does the passage imply about a term that looks ordinary but is technical?
options: It is harmless because it looks familiar
It can mislead outsiders into treating it as casual
It is always clearer than a technical term
It should be avoided by all writers

questions.text: Why might a reader overestimate the consequence of a finding?
options: Because the findings are always false
Because the ordinary meaning of 'significant' silently replaces the technical one
Because writers never define their terms

vocabulary.definition: standard wording that appears in many documents and is rarely questioned
a duty that a party is legally or morally bound to fulfil
a level or point that must be reached for something to take effect
to judge something to be greater or more important than it really is

paragraph_translations: قد تبدو بعض المصطلحات التقنية عادية، مما يجعلها أخطر لا أقل خطرًا. فالمحامي الذي يصف بندًا بأنه «شروط نمطية» يشير إلى أن لغته معيارية ومن المتوقع أن تكون غير مثيرة للجدل، لكن العبارة قد تخفي التزامًا لا يلاحظه غير المختص أبدًا. ويعتمد المختصون على هذا الألفة للتواصل بكفاءة، غير أن الغرباء قد يخطئون فيحسبون المصطلح الروتيني عاديًا.

يواجه الباحثون مشكلة مماثلة مع كلمات مثل «significant»، التي تدل في الإحصاء على عتبة احتمالية لا على الأهمية بالمعنى اليومي. فالقارئ الذي يأخذ الكلمة على ظاهرها قد يبالغ في تقدير أثر النتيجة. لذلك يعرّف الكتّاب الجيدون هذه المصطلحات عند أول ورود لها، حتى لا يحل المعنى العادي محل المعنى التقني دون أن يشعر أحد.
